text: I can calculate the miss window of a stampede (request rate × rebuild time) and explain why it feeds on itself.
I can compare a rebuild lock, request coalescing and probabilistic early refresh and pick one for a given key.
I can defend a database against cache penetration with negative caching and a correctly sized Bloom filter.
I can explain why adding cache nodes doesn't fix a hot key and apply local caching or key replication instead.
I can prevent an avalanche with TTL jitter and plan for a cold cache with replication, warming and database protection.
